title: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push companion spec
description: Define a new JMAP Chat Push companion spec (urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:push). Inspired by draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-02. Mobile chat clients need inline message content in push notification payloads so they can show a notification without a follow-up HTTPS fetch. Spec should: extend PushSubscription with a chatPush filter (per-chat, per-kind filtering); define a ChatMessagePush object carrying messageId, chatId, chatName, senderId, senderDisplayName, bodySnippet (truncated plaintext), sentAt; handle E2EE deployments (push only metadata, no body); define rate-limit capability properties.
